song.title: Beautiful
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G C I see Your face in every sunrise . Em Dsus The colors of the morning are inside Your eyes .G C The world awakens in the light of the day . Em Dsus I look up to the sky and say You're beautiful
[V2] .G C I see Your power in the moonlit night . Em Dsus Where planets are in motion and galaxies are bright .G C We are amazed in the light of the stars . Em Dsus It's all proclaiming who You are You're beautiful, You're beautiful
[V3] .G C I see you there hanging on a tree . Em Dsus You bled and then you died and then you rose again for me .G C Now you are sitting on Your heavenly throne .Em Soon we will be coming home You're beautiful, you're beautiful
[V4] .G C When we arrive at eternity's shore . Em Dsus Where death is just a memory and tears are no more .G C We'll enter in as the wedding bells ring .Em Dsus Your bride will come together and we'll sing
song.author: Phil Wickham
